subject: general
question: In which year was International Booker Prize established?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2005__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** inaugural Man Booker International Prize was judged by John Carey (Chair), Alberto Manguel and Azar Nafisi.**
 
• He nominees were announced on** 2 June 2005 at Georgetown University in Washington, D.C. Albanian novelist Ismail Kadare was named the inaugural International Prize winner in 2005.**
 
• **The International Booker Prize** is an international literary award hosted in the United Kingdom.** The introduction of the International Prize to complement the Man Booker Prize was announced in June 2004.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Something to Answer For is a 1968 novel by the English writer P. H. Newby.
 
• **Its chief claim to fame is that in 1969 it won the inaugural Booker Prize, which would go on to become one of the major literary awards in the English-speaking world.**
 
• Midnight's Children is a 1981 novel by author Salman Rushdie.
 
• Published by Jonathan Cape with cover design by Bill Botten. It portrays India's transition from the British colonial rule to the independence and the partition of India.​
